Rin: Heads-up re: Midtown Dev Night next week. Need final plan for booth swap, speaking slide links, swag sizes, and post-event webinar follow-up flow. Quick sync here.
Omar: Speaking slots locked: Rin 18:15 lightning, Raj 19:00 panel. Tess can host the post-talk 20min Q&A/demo.
Tess: Ill bring the demo VM image and the small private dataset sample. Need a spare USB-C hub and HDMI adapter.
Raj: Swag: ordered 220 beanies, 120 stickers, 80 water bottles. Vendor asked if we want embroidered logo on beanies (adds 6 days). Prefer plain tag-free for faster ship?
Rin: Skip embroidery. Fast ship preferred. Omar, can you confirm attendee QR flow? We want form -> funnel -> RSVP + demo opt-in.
Omar: Proposed: QR -> short form (name,email,company,interest) -> webhook to HubSpot with tag midtown_devnight and UTM midtown_2024. Then auto-add to webinar nurture sequence.
PackBot: Crate booking created. Pickup 2024-05-02 09:00, carrier QuickDrop AWB QD-445566.
Tess: Run-of-show draft: 16:30 load-in, 17:45 speaker check, 18:15 lightning, 19:00 panel, 19:45 booth demos, 20:30 teardown. Need two volunteers for booth at 19:45.
Raj: I can cover 18:30-20:00. Rin, can you cover 19:45-20:30?
Rin: Yes. Also request for a short one-pager: benchmark snapshot showing 99th perc latency and cost per 1k tokens vs baseline. Omar, can Applied ML ops distill to one column PDF?
Omar: Will ping Applied ML. Also recommend we include a short post-event webinar invite card on the table: "Cant make it? Join our follow-up webinar May 10" with signup QR.
Tess: For packing list: 2x banner stands, 1x crate, 1x projector, 3x laptops, power strip, gaffer tape, swag boxes. Ill add foam inserts note.
Raj: T-shirt sizes? We didn't order tees but if we want small sizes for beanies extras, suggest we keep 30 S, 70 M, 80 L, 40 XL in backup budget.
Rin: No tees this time. If vendor can swap 20 beanies to 20 extra stickers that's fine.
PackBot: Vendor update: swags shipped 2024-05-01 ETA 2024-05-02. Tracking: https://track.quickdrop/QD-445566
Omar: After event: plan triggers: 1) hit HubSpot webhook -> assign to CS queue, 2) send follow-up email with webinar invite + bench one-pager, 3) create nurture task for interest leads.
Tess: Reminder for speakers: slide deck by Fri EOD, 16:00 run-through rehearsal Fri 10:30.
Rin: Great. Final confirmations by Thu midday so Ops can pack Wed. If anything blocks shout here and well reassign. :raised_hands:
